0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Jubkhal has a pair of metal containers in his hands, and they appear to be piping hot.

24.original: Deliver the metal containers to the lookouts.

48.original: You're the traveler who rescued the child of Mehvan and Qerasaf, yes? Do you have a moment to spare for the brave souls that watch over our village?

49.original: With the Radiant Host shorthanded, the courageous among us have volunteered to climb those treacherous cliffs and keep lookout for any approaching beasts.

50.original: I would make their long days easier with a home-cooked meal, but I cannot reach the summit on my own. Every mount that might carry me there is otherwise indisposed, but I don't believe that will prove a problem to one so resourceful as you.

51.original: If you would be so kind, please deliver these meals to the lookouts at the summit. I'll pay you for your troubles, if that will help speed things along.

52.original: Sheer mountain cliffs are no obstacle to one such as you, I'm sure. Please deliver these meals to the lookouts above─doubtless they're hungry by now.

53.original: That smell's set my stomach rumblin' something fierce. Pray tell me you've brought enough to share.

54.original: It's <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> for me!? Why, thank you! I was beginning to dread the rest of my watch. There's nothin' like a spiced curry to keep hunger away.

55.original: Hmm, I've never seen a container quite like this before. Not a drop of curry was spilled in your flight, and it's still pipin' hot! Thank you, friend!

56.original: There's nothin' like a curry to get you through an uneventful watch. Thanks for bringin' it all this way, friend!

57.original: The sounds of my stomach would drown out the alarum... Say, you didn't bring anything to eat, did you?

58.original: Ah, I knew I recognized that heavenly scent! Spices to fortify the spirits and tea to sharpen the senses. This will tide me over until my replacement arrives.

59.original: Thanks to you, the rest of my watch should go by in a flash. I'll toast to your generosity when I'm done!

60.original: I can see you've delivered the meals. If you had eaten them, I would be able to smell your guilt. I am grateful, as I'm sure the lookouts are as well.

61.original: Long ago we would post soldiers upon those cliffs, that we might see invaders approaching by sea. To think something much worse would eventually cross the ocean...

62.original: Regardless, we are blessed that nature has provided us a way to watch for danger. I hope to keep our lookouts fed for as long as I can.
